xBRIEFInfo.description: Bug cohort story for GitHub issue #3236 (operator-approved swarm 2026-08-10).

plan.title: fix(migrate): rewrite hybrid xBRIEFInfo@0.6 envelopes on already-xbrief trees

narratives.Description: migrate:xbrief no-ops on xbrief-only trees that still have hybrid xBRIEFInfo.version 0.6, while doctor reports behind-major and points operators at migrate:xbrief. transformArtifactV06ToV08 already accepts hybrid input (#2974); runXbriefMigration must apply it in place when no vbrief/ tree remains.
narratives.UserStory: As a Directive operator, I want migrate:xbrief to rewrite residual hybrid xBRIEFInfo@0.6 envelopes in place, so that doctor xbrief-envelope-version clears without out-of-band transforms.
narratives.ImplementationPlan: In packages/core/src/xbrief-migrate/migrate-project.ts, when the tree is already on xbrief/ with no vbrief/ content, scan xbrief/**/*.xbrief.json for hybrid xBRIEFInfo@0.6 and apply transformArtifactV06ToV08Transactional in place (idempotent). Keep the existing noop message only when there are truly no residual 0.6 envelopes (schemas-only residual may still point at directive update). Add unit tests in migrate-project.test.ts and transforms fixtures covering hybrid-only trees. Cite #3236 in CHANGELOG [Unreleased]. Do not change transform semantics beyond orchestration.
narratives.Overview: fix(migrate): rewrite hybrid xBRIEFInfo@0.6 envelopes on already-xbrief trees
narratives.NonGoals: Epic #3237 children; docs-only mitigation; changing consumer repo rulesets.
narratives.AcceptanceJustification: Three acceptance items cover fix, fail-closed gate, and regression tests for this single-issue bug.

narrative.Acceptance: Given xbrief/**/*.xbrief.json with xBRIEFInfo.version 0.6 and no vbrief/, when migrate:xbrief runs, envelopes become xBRIEFInfo@0.8 and exit 0 with a rewrite report.

items.title: In-place hybrid 0.6 rewrite on xbrief-only trees

narrative.Acceptance: Given already-0.8 hybrid trees, when migrate:xbrief re-runs, it no-ops without corrupting files; doctor xbrief-envelope-version is clear after a successful rewrite.

items.title: Idempotent second pass and doctor path

narrative.Acceptance: Given unit tests for hybrid-only trees, when vitest runs on xbrief-migrate, new cases pass; CHANGELOG cites #3236.
